completion_criteria.description: Per-model token consumption of one full live-AgentCore e2e run and the current Bedrock tokens-per-day Service Quota values are measured and recorded with machine-captured provenance.
A fix direction (quota increase, consumption reduction, scenario scoping, suite split, or a combination) is chosen and ratified by the human program owner with machine-captured UTC.
The chosen fix is implemented and a full live-AgentCore e2e pass fits within the daily token budget (measured need at or below the effective quota), with the validating evidence recorded.

constraints: The pinned engine runtime/continuity/** is used unmodified; preparation used the pinned store API directly (the MI-005/MI-006-R1 evidenced mechanism) because creating a new continuity/bindings/** file is blocked during the SD-001 period.
Completion occurs only through the engine completion gate (all required criteria passed with linked immutable Evidence) and the truthful backlog write-back.
Outward-facing actions (an AWS Service Quota increase request) require explicit human program owner authorization before execution.
Implementation and ship of in-repo changes go through the repository normal ship mechanisms (backlog-next closing phase), never around them.
exclusions: No byte change to runtime/continuity/**, the hook registration, or .claude/settings.json (engine frozen during the SD-001 period).
No edit to any published continuity suite and no mutation of any recorded historical or immutable result.
No Skills, Packs, or bindings change outside the MI-007 governed-learning owner-applied path.
No period-verdict or per-criterion claim; observational dogfooding-ledger appends only.
expected_outputs: a recorded per-model gap sizing (measured tokens per full live run versus tokens-per-day quota) with machine-captured provenance
the implemented fix with budget-fit validation evidence and the truthful backlog completion write-back

history.note: SD-001 standing-period work. Selected by the /backlog-next deterministic rank rule (top-ranked QUEUED, rank 1); prepared through the pinned store API per the MI-005/MI-006-R1 evidenced mechanism.

objective: Make one full live-AgentCore e2e run fit within the dev-account Bedrock daily token budget: size the measured per-model token gap against the tokens-per-day Service Quotas, record an owner-ratified fix direction (quota increase, consumption reduction, scenario scoping, suite split, or a combination), implement it through the repository normal ship mechanisms, and validate that a full pass no longer exhausts the daily budget.
required_evidence: measurement record for criterion 1 (per-model CloudWatch token totals for one full run plus the current Service Quota values, with capture commands and machine-captured UTC)
agent-and-human-review record for criterion 2 (the direction analysis plus program-owner authorization with machine-captured UTC)
budget-fit validation record for criterion 3 (post-fix evidence that one full pass fits the daily budget)
